extra.final_summary:
Fixed data quality issues and computed average body mass by species (54 valid rows after exclusions).

Issues found/fixed:
- species: misspellings "Adeile"→Adelie, "Gentto"→Gentoo (normalized)
- island: case variant "biscoe"→Biscoe (normalized)
- body_mass_g: stored as text with commas; cast to numeric
- body_mass_g: 3 impossible out-of-range values (3,650,000; 3,500,000; 6,000,000 g) excluded per rules [2500, 6500]

Results (mean body_mass_g):
- Adelie: 3500.0
- Chinstrap: 3907.8125
- Gentoo: 5248.3333

Caveat: 3 rows excluded due to impossible body masses; 1 text-formatted value ("3,800") was successfully parsed.
